basic_identification.full_title: Wooden Flush Door Shutters (Solid Core Type) — Specification, Part 2: Particle Board, High Density Fibre Board, Medium Density Fibre Board and Fibre Hardboard Face Panels (Fourth Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Civil Engineering / Doors, Windows and Shutters (approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Doors, Windows and Shutters Sectional Committee of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Doors, Windows and Shutters Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard specifies the physical, dimensional, constructional, and performance testing criteria for solid core wooden flush door shutters with face panels made of particle board, high density fibre board (HDF), medium density fibre board (MDF), or fibre hardboard, suitable for use in both internal and external positions. Amendment No. 1 explicitly clarifies that the standard covers different constructions of doors (stiles and rails as well as particle/MDF board door blanks) and acts in addition or alternative to IS 2202 (Part 1).

amendment_slips.description: Formally updates the scope to cover door blanks and stiles and rails constructions. Establishes pencil hardness criteria for decorative foil faces, sets a maximum 5% swelling limit for core materials, defines door blank Grade requirements, and exempts edge-banded or beaded solid core door blanks from end immersion and knife testing.

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the statutory 'Plywood and Wooden Flush Door Shutters (Quality Control) Order' (QCO) issued by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, all solid core wooden flush door shutters with particle board, MDF, HDF, and fibre hardboard face panels must carry the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, distributing, or stocking non-certified flush doors is a criminal offense under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. MSMEs are granted phased transition periods, and export-only shipments are exempt. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to building construction doors.

requirements.detail: Every door shutter must carry the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) marked legibly and indelibly on any of its edges, along with the manufacturer's name/trademark, brand name, batch number, date of manufacture, size, and the standard number (IS 2202 Part 2).
Under Amendment No. 1, the standard explicitly covers different constructions of doors, including doors having stiles and rails as well as doors having particle/MDF board door blanks.
The requirements given in IS 2202 (Part 2) are in addition or alternative to the plywood face panel requirements defined in IS 2202 (Part 1).

For BDPV, PDPV, and MDPV types of flush door shutters, face panels of particle board, MDF, HDF, and fibre hardboard with decorative faces of PVC foils, other types of foils, or ABS sheets must pass 1H of the pencil hardness test as per Annex C to IS 17637. Face panels of prelaminated MDF or HDF must meet the Type IV abrasion resistance requirements of IS 14587. Face panels with decorative laminates or continuous pressed laminates (CPL) must meet the type VLS requirements of IS 2046.
In Clause 6.4, the term 'core' is substituted with 'infill board/core' to align with modern manufacturing blanks and stave-type layouts.

The core particle board, MDF, or HDF board must exhibit highly controlled thickness swelling when tested: the swelling in thickness after 2 hours of immersion in water, when tested in accordance with IS 2380 (Part 17), shall not exceed a strict maximum of 5 percent.

The face panels must be formed by gluing under hot, cold, or high frequency press processes onto the faces of the particle board, HDF board, MDF board, or fibre hardboard, with or without decorative laminates, PVC foils, CPL, or ABS sheets. The combined thickness of the face panels must be at least 3 mm.

Flush door shutters manufactured with solid door blanks of particle board, MDF, or veneered particle board must conform to Grade 1 of IS 3087, Grade 1 of IS 12406, and Grade 1 of IS 3097, respectively. The edge-banding/beading must consist of solid timber of any species (preferably from Annex B of Part 1) or of PVC or ABS material, applied to the full thickness of the door, and its thickness must pass the screw withdrawal test.
Under Amendment No. 1, for solid core door blanks featuring edge banding or beaded edges, the end immersion test and knife (glue adhesion) test shall not be applicable.

The door must resist screw pullout during hinge assembly: when tested in accordance with IS 4020 (Part 16), the minimum load required to completely withdraw the wood screw must be at least 1 000 N, with zero local delamination, chipping, or cracking.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 2202 (Part 2) : 2022 is the mandatory national Indian Standard safety specification regulating solid core wooden flush door shutters with face panels made of particle board, HDF, MDF, or fibre hardboard [1]. Under the national Plywood and Wooden Flush Door Shutters Quality Control Order (QCO), all such shutters sold or imported in India must be certified by the Bureau of Indian Standards and bear the Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Amendment No. 1 (August 2024) introduces critical updates [1, 2]: it expands the scope to cover diverse doors with stiles and rails as well as solid board door blanks [1]; mandates a 1H pencil hardness for PVC or ABS foil-covered faces [2]; restricts infill core thickness swelling to a maximum of 5% [2]; and explicitly waives the end immersion and knife tests for edge-banded or beaded door blanks [2]—ensuring structural integrity and resistance to extreme moisture and mechanical misuse in residential and commercial buildings.
